request: Design simple locking mechanism in the area of the hook to secure carried load.

parameters.locking_mechanism_type: removable locking pin / safety pin provision (through-hole across hook throat)
parameters.hole_axis: Y (through thickness, from +Y side face to -Y side face)
parameters.hole_location_definition: Located in SEC_03 near the hook opening; center positioned relative to existing hook references (top pad and notch/seat) to close the mouth of the hook without interfering with the seat contact surface.

actions.relational_constraint: Position the locking mechanism in the area of the hook; locate the pin hole so it bridges the open mouth above the concave seat/notch, preventing unintended disengagement while keeping the seat (contact) surface functional.
actions.unresolved_reference: Locking mechanism geometry/type not specified; this plan assumes a simple removable locking pin solution. Exact pin diameter, exact center coordinates (x,z), and required clearance to the carried load are not provided; confirm intended load diameter and insertion path to finalize hole position.
steps: Functional placement decision (hook-end context): Use SEC_03 as the lock integration zone because it contains the load engagement geometry (concave seat FACE 7 / face_code 0012) and the opening/mouth bounded by the end-side faces (face_code 0015 at y=+3 and face_code 0017 at y=-3). The locking feature should cross the opening (throat) above the concave seat so the carried load remains seated on the notch cylinder while a pin blocks escape.

Select sketch plane: choose the positive-Y end-side face of the hook feature (SEC_03, face_code 0015, Brep_id FACE 14) as the sketch plane so the resulting hole axis is normal to this plane (along global Y) and will naturally pass through to the opposite end-side face (face_code 0017, Brep_id FACE 12).

Create hole center references (robust constraints): (1) Reference the top end pad face (face_code 0014, Brep_id FACE 17, z=15) to control vertical placement; dimension the hole center a set offset below this face (parameter: z_offset_from_top, chosen to keep the pin above the notch). (2) Reference the concave seat/notch cylinder (face_code 0012, Brep_id FACE 7) to ensure the hole is located above the seat’s highest functional contact zone; set a minimum vertical separation so the pin does not reduce the seat bearing arc. (3) Reference the outer rounded boss cylinder (face_code 0011, Brep_id FACE 10) and/or the extreme-end rounding cylinder (face_code 0016, Brep_id FACE 13, if needed) to maintain adequate edge distance from the outer wall.

Sketch geometry: on face_code 0015, sketch a circle with diameter = pin_hole_diameter_mm (2.5). Constrain the circle center in X-Z such that: (a) it sits above the concave seat/notch cylinder by at least recommended_clearances_mm.min_distance_above_seat; (b) it lies near the hook mouth so a pin inserted will block the opening; and (c) it retains recommended_clearances_mm.min_edge_distance to the outer boss cylinder wall (face_code 0011).

Cut feature: perform an Extrude Cut / Hole feature from the sketched circle ‘Through All’ along -Y direction, ensuring it breaks through the opposite end-side face (face_code 0017). This creates a through-hole that accepts a separate locking pin spanning the hook width.

Interference/intent check: verify the cut does not remove excessive material from the notch cylinder (face_code 0012) and does not weaken the outer boss cylinder (face_code 0011) below acceptable ligament thickness; if the hole intersects the notch arc, move the center upward (toward face_code 0014) and/or slightly back from the extreme end while keeping it across the opening.

actions.operation: Add chamfer to locking pin hole edges (deburr / lead-in)
actions.target: New locking pin through-hole edges at the hook end
actions.relational_constraint: Chamfer both sides of the new through-hole to ease pin insertion and reduce stress concentration at the hole edge.
actions.unresolved_reference: Exact chamfer size depends on manufacturing process and pin lead-in requirement; 0.5 mm is a typical starting value.
steps: Edge selection: select the circular edges created where the new through-hole intersects the positive-Y end-side face (face_code 0015) and the negative-Y end-side face (face_code 0017).
Chamfer operation: apply a 0.5 mm equal-distance chamfer (or equivalent deburr) to both circular edges to create a lead-in for the locking pin and reduce burrs/stress risers.

Verification: confirm chamfers do not break into adjacent critical surfaces (especially near the notch/seat region, face_code 0012) and maintain adequate edge distance to the outer boss cylinder (face_code 0011).

intention: Add a simple locking function at the hook to secure the carried load (prevent unintended disengagement).
Implement the locking function with minimal part complexity by providing a robust, manufacturable provision for a removable locking pin spanning the hook throat above the concave seat.
